notes_for_editor: Read: the FFLOS register page, Wikipedia's October Mountain State Forest article, and the Digital Commonwealth Whitney Tower record. Unresolved conflict: a Forest Fire Lookout Association Massachusetts Facebook post (search snippet only, login-walled, not opened) describes the 1896 tower as wooden, against the register's stone; a Berkshires Gone By post captions a 1929 photo of the tower on the Whitney estate, called The Antlers, as no longer standing. Neither is used. The Digital Commonwealth photo is ca. 1920 to 1925 and titled Whitney Tower, but its link to this tower is inferred from the title and place, not stated. A Massachusetts fire tower pin list (rk-mass2.org FireTower1.pdf) mentions a third state station built in the town of Mount Washington, undated; it may or may not relate to the 1914 replacement, and it is not used. The register's 'location' (Berkshire County) is confirmed by the Digital Commonwealth place tag. No corrections proposed.
